versioning-settings.title: Versioning settings
versioning-settings.repo-mode-private-hint: Creates its own .git inside this project folder. If this folder is already inside another git repository, this creates a nested repository your outer git may not read correctly — use "Use enclosing repository" instead in that case.
versioning-settings.repo-mode-enclosing-hint: Reuses a git repository this project folder is already inside, scoping every operation to this project's own files. Falls back to Private automatically when no enclosing repository is found.
versioning-settings.auto-version-gap-hours-hint: When you come back to this project after being away longer than this, your next edit is automatically checkpointed as it stood before that edit.
